pages.text: Bauble Fruits open extra bauble slots. Slay high-tier parasites while wearing the $(item)Blessed Ring$() to find seed fragments, join four into a $(item)Corrupted Seed$(), plant it on infested ground and defend the sapling until it bears fruit.

Purify the $(item)Corrupted Fruit$() on a single Imbuement Altar ringed by four receptacles: the colours of the dust choose which slot it opens. Eating it uncleansed opens a random slot, and costs your life.
